info.title: worker-protocol — metrics
info.description: Named quantities accumulated over declared periods. The Descriptor is the catalog: this surface answers values and never lists what exists (MET-21).

servers.description: MET-1. The address the `metrics` entry declares, resolved per DESC-12.

address.description: Read from the Worker's Descriptor and resolved per DESC-12. Never assembled by a caller (ENDP-1). The default is `/` and not a host on purpose: a client that was never given an address should fail at its own origin rather than reach somebody else's.

get.description: MET-8. A read names one metric and answers one series. MET-18: a dimension a read neither fixes nor breaks down by is accumulated over, so an unfiltered answer is the total and never a slice the Worker chose.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: MET-8. One of the metrics the entry declares. One not declared is `404`.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: MET-8. Required where the metric declares more than one, and omittable where it declares exactly one.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: MET-11. Inclusive. Absent, the start of the current bucket.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: MET-11. Exclusive — the interval is half-open, so two adjacent reads add up. Absent, the instant the Worker answers.

parameters.name: by
parameters.description: MET-19. Break down by a dimension, and only by one that declared its set of values: over a free dimension nothing would bound the number of series.

parameters.name: dimensions
parameters.description: MET-16. Each dimension the metric declares, fixed by a parameter named exactly as the dimension. The names are the Worker's own and are read from its Descriptor, so they are not enumerated here. A value outside a declared set is `400`; where a dimension declares no set, any string is accepted and may match nothing.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: ENDP-21. Opaque, produced only by the Worker, never constructed by a caller. Absent from an answer at the end of the collection.

parameters.name: Worker-Protocol-Capability-Version
parameters.description: ENDP-6. The Capability version the caller expects. A Worker that cannot answer it refuses the request whole with `400` and `unsupported_version`, and never substitutes its own.

200.description: MET-14. Buckets ascending by start, in the shared page envelope.

Worker-Protocol-Edition.description: ENDP-5. The edition that produced this answer. A caller that sees one it did not expect re-reads the Descriptor rather than parsing the body.

Worker-Protocol-Capability-Version.description: ENDP-5. The Capability version that produced this answer.
